name: aidan
description: Find, browse and read the articles, posts and videos you saved to AIDAN, inside ChatGPT. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Bring everything you save from Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and the web into ChatGPT. Ask a question, and any save that helps comes back.

AIDAN is the memory layer for everything you save. Instead of saving on each platform separately, you save to AIDAN: any reel, post, video or article worth keeping from Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and the web. Later, when you are solving a problem, something you saved in the past may already hold the answer. This plugin brings your AIDAN library into ChatGPT: just ask "What have I saved on this?" and it brings back what fits.

ChatGPT gets read-only access to your library through three tools: find the saves that help with a topic or task you are working on, browse your most recent saves in order, and open any single save in full. Every result links back to its original source.

Read-only, and only ever your own library. ChatGPT can read what you saved to AIDAN and nothing else: it can never add, change or delete a save, and it never sees your browsing history or social feeds. You need an AIDAN account to connect. Disconnect anytime from ChatGPT's settings.
defaultPrompt: What have I saved about pitch decks?
Show me my most recent saves.
Find something I saved that could help with my current project.

positive.prompt: What have I saved about doing things that don't scale?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved Paul Graham essay "Do Things That Don't Scale" with its summary, key points and source link. Only the demo account's own saves are returned.

positive.description: Browse recent saves without a topic
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's saves newest first, each with its title, platform, capture date and source link.

positive.description: Find a save and read its full content
positive.prompt: Find the Sam Altman essay I saved on how to be successful, open its full text from my AIDAN save and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved essay with find_saves, then opens its full readable content from AIDAN with get_save_detail and summarizes the whole article with a link to the source.

positive.description: Use saves to help with a task
positive.prompt: I'm writing a system prompt for a customer support bot. Have I saved anything that could help?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved Anthropic prompt engineering overview as relevant material, with its key points and link, and uses it to help with the task.

positive.prompt: What have I saved about Kae Capital?
positive.expected_behavior: find_saves returns no save about Kae Capital (at most loosely related 'possible' matches, never an error), and ChatGPT says nothing saved is about Kae Capital.

negative.description: Deleting or editing a save is not supported (read-only plugin). ChatGPT should say AIDAN can't change saves from ChatGPT and point to the AIDAN app.
negative.prompt: Delete my most recent save in AIDAN.

negative.description: Saving new content is not supported from ChatGPT. Capture happens in the AIDAN extension, mobile app or web app; ChatGPT should explain this rather than call a tool.
AIDAN has no access to browsing history or other users' data. ChatGPT should explain that AIDAN only holds what the user explicitly saved.
negative.prompt: Use AIDAN to show me my browsing history from yesterday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: The first suggested prompt now asks about pitch decks, matching the saves AIDAN's onboarding walks new users through, and the plugin now sets a composer icon (the current AIDAN logo). No change to tools or data access.
